natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: The two observed declines (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the funnel stage where inherited evidence is strongest and most mutually corroborating: memory_86 (shortened onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value) and memory_31 (signup field reduction produced a durable first-week activation lift). Two independent records pointing the same direction is the best available support, and the intervention attacks the actual measured regression rather than a symptom. I am spending both verification pulls on exactly those two records because they are the load-bearing claims for the action I intend; if either turns out to be a small, short-horizon, or non-replicated result, the case weakens materially and I would fall back to activation_messaging (memory_91), which targets the same funnel but is a single, less-specific record. Promotional_pricing is the tempting response to the competitor's entry pricing, but memory_73 explicitly records a 12% retention cut against a near-term revenue lift, which is directly adverse to the stated objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue; I decline it despite the competitive pressure. Referral_incentive (memory_57) and enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) are plausible but do not address either measured decline this quarter. Caveats I am carrying forward rather than discarding: these are consolidated summaries, not raw results; memory_31 is 64 days old and memory_86 is 24 days old, both predating the competitor's launch, so the population mix may have shifted; and neither record as summarized states effect size, duration, or whether the activation lift persisted past week one. I therefore run this as a standard experiment with retention and downstream qualified-revenue instrumentation, not just completion-rate instrumentation, so the result does not repeat the memory_73 failure mode of a good top-of-funnel number masking a bad long-run one. Whatever we learn should be written back with effect sizes and horizons attached so the next session is not verifying this same claim again.
